task: Show a doughnut points summary and left-align the test results column.
nonGoals: Backend or rubric changes, invented final scores for incomplete audits, public deployment or unrelated local services.

outcomes.description: A visual doughnut shows earned, missed and not-yet-scored points, with total score for complete reports and a clearly labelled subtotal when incomplete.
outcomes.evidence: Runtime rendering and points arithmetic regressions for complete, partial and empty results.

outcomes.description: Result labels, points and the column heading share a left alignment.

process.description: Commit the plan before implementation and run source-bound evaluation, independent review and hosted CI.

styleEfficiency.description: Reuse existing report colours and native CSS without dependencies.

exitTest.reason: Report chart and alignment changes do not alter agent workflow or portability.
